title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of employers' organizations

description.narrative: The Serbian Association of Employers (SAE) is the main employer representative in the tripartite social dialogue, with its membership mainly consisting of domestic small-scale businesses. In an increasingly competitive environment for business representation, attracting new members is becoming more challenging. The direct access of competing associations and chambers to government circles undermines the value of social dialogue and the SAE’s ability to effectively influence policy and law-making, both of which hamper its growth. The SAE is also under pressure from its members to provide expertise on emerging business challenges, actively engage in and shape policy debates, and effectively represent their interests in the process of aligning national legislation with the EU Acquis. The ILO interventions for 2024-2025 are designed to address the aforementioned critical areas. One key focus is on strengthening the SAE’s policy role, particularly by building on the results of the previous biennium in the area of skills development. This work is informed by the 2022 Enabling Environment for Sustainable Enterprises assessment, in which inadequate skills supply and workforce quality were identified as major obstacles to business growth. In response, the ILO supported a rapid Skills for Trade and Economic Diversification exercise in the hotel industry, resulting in the development of a Sector Skills Strategy. Incorporating quantitative and qualitative data as well as the input of a wide range of stakeholders, the strategy was officially launched in October 2024. The second area of support focuses on membership growth, diversification and engagement. An assessment will be conducted to gauge member satisfaction, identify needs, and inform the development of a comprehensive membership and communication strategy. Support will include the implementation of priority measures such as optimized membership management, enhanced communication, and innovative outreach approaches.
